The colours a spec is built with

Source: R/theme.R
viz_theme.Rd

Every ec_*() function takes a theme. Pass "light" (default) or "dark" for the built-in palettes, or a named list overriding any of their entries — mediaplanr.viz ships no client's colours, so a brand palette is supplied here rather than patched into the option afterwards.

Usage

viz_theme(theme = "light")

Arguments

theme

"light", "dark", or a named list of overrides. A list may set base to say which palette it starts from; without it, light.

Value

A named list: ink, ink_2, ink_3, surface, rule, grid, accent, owner (a character vector), topline, and status (a named character vector).

Details

Three roles are kept deliberately separate. accent is the plan's own colour. owner is a categorical ramp assigned to subplan keys in the order they are attached, so the same subplan is the same colour in every chart of one plan. status maps mediaplanr::status_levels() — plus "" for unset — to semantic colours, and is never reused for anything else.

Examples

viz_theme("dark")$accent
#> [1] "#3FB4BE"
viz_theme(list(accent = "#B0004F"))$accent
#> [1] "#B0004F"
